title: 通天河安全路
subtitle: 看起来结实，也要先认真确认
origin: 《西游记》第四十七至四十九回背景延伸（过河后的安全小故事，非原著独立事件）

moral.zh: 面对陌生的冰面、水路或捷径，不能只看表面；请熟悉环境的大人检查，并选择有保护的路线。
moral.en: On unfamiliar ice, water, or shortcuts, appearances are not enough. Ask knowledgeable adults to check and choose a protected route.

pages.zh: 过了通天河，大家在岸边村落歇脚。村旁的一条小支流结了冰，八戒想从这里走近路。
pages.en: After crossing the Tongtian River, they rested in a village. A small nearby tributary had frozen, and Bajie wanted to take a shortcut across it.
pages.prompt: Full Journey to the West team stands on a dry protected riverbank looking across a broad sparkling frozen river in gentle winter sunlight; wooden railings and village houses nearby, no one on ice, no text.

pages.zh: 八戒看见商队留下的车印，刚想抄近路，沙僧提醒：“旧车印不代表今天也安全。”
pages.en: Bajie saw old wagon tracks and wanted a shortcut, but Sha warned, “Old tracks do not prove the ice is safe today.”
pages.prompt: Bajie points from the dry bank toward faint old tracks on ice while Sha gently raises a stop hand; Tang Seng, Wukong and White Dragon Horse remain behind the railing, no text.

pages.zh: 陈家庄的大人带来测冰杆、长绳和不同颜色的圆牌，和师徒一起检查。
pages.en: Adults from Chen Village brought ice poles, safety ropes, and colored round markers to inspect the route with the travelers.
pages.prompt: Responsible village adults in warm ancient clothing demonstrate long rounded measuring poles and thick safety ropes from the protected bank; colored blank circle markers, no letters or text.

pages.zh: 靠近芦苇的冰层最薄，流水转弯处也会发出空空的声音，不能走。
pages.en: Ice near reeds was thinnest, and bends above moving water sounded hollow, so those areas were closed.
pages.prompt: Wukong and village adults identify thin ice near reeds from behind a rope barrier, placing red round markers on shore aligned with unsafe zones; no one steps on ice, no text.

pages.zh: 村民在上游架着一座有扶手的冬桥。虽然远一点，却经过每日检查。
pages.en: Upstream, villagers maintained a winter bridge with handrails. It was farther away, but inspected every day.
pages.prompt: A sturdy low wooden winter bridge with full railings crosses a narrow calm section upstream; village adults inspect planks while team approaches on dry path, no text.

pages.zh: 悟空把红牌放在危险处，八戒把绿牌排向安全桥，沙僧沿路检查护绳。
pages.en: Wukong marked unsafe areas red, Bajie pointed green markers toward the bridge, and Sha checked the handline.
pages.prompt: Team works from dry land: Wukong places red circle markers by closed riverbank, Bajie lays green circle markers along path, Sha checks bridge rope; no writing or text.

pages.zh: 大家牵着白龙马慢慢过桥，前后留出距离，没有人跑跳或挤在一起。
pages.en: Everyone crossed slowly with White Dragon Horse, leaving space between them. No one ran, jumped, or crowded.
pages.prompt: Full team crosses the sturdy railed wooden bridge in single file with generous spacing, White Dragon Horse walking calmly, village guide leading; safe winter scene, no text.

pages.zh: 越过小支流，师徒向金兜山走去。八戒说：“真正的近路，是能让大家平安到达的路。”
pages.en: Beyond the tributary, they walked toward Jindou Mountain. “The best shortcut brings everyone there safely,” said Bajie.
pages.prompt: Team gathers on dry far bank beside green circle marker, looking back at safe bridge and sparkling closed ice route; warm winter sunset, no text.
